detail.question: Combien de commandes par annee ?
Quel jour de la semaine recoit le plus de commandes ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT 
    DAYNAME(TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS jour_semaine,
    COUNT(*) AS nombre_commandes
FROM entrepot."orders" o
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY DAYNAME(TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))
ORDER BY nombre_commandes DESC
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: A quelle heure de la journee nos clients commandent-ils le plus ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT
    DATE_PART('hour', TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS heure_de_la_journee,
    COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_commandes
FROM entrepot."orders" AS o
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY nombre_de_commandes DESC
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: Quel chiffre d'affaires par etat du client ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT
    c.customer_state AS etat_client,
    SUM(oi.price) AS chiffre_affaires
FROM entrepot."customers" c
JOIN entrepot."orders" o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN entrepot."order_items" oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY chiffre_affaires DESC
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: Les vendeurs de quels etats livrent le plus vite ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT
    s.seller_state AS etat_vendeur,
    AVG(DATEDIFF('day', TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP), TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP))) AS delai_moyen_jours
FROM entrepot."orders" o
JOIN entrepot."order_items" oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN entrepot."sellers" s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.seller_state
ORDER BY delai_moyen_jours ASC
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: Quelle est la note moyenne par categorie de produit, en anglais, pour les categories evaluees au moins cinq cents fois ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT
    t.product_category_name_english AS categorie_anglaise,
    AVG(r.review_score) AS note_moyenne
FROM
    entrepot."order_reviews" r
JOIN
    entrepot."order_items" oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN
    entrepot."products" p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN
    entrepot."product_category_name_translation" t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
GROUP BY
    t.product_category_name_english
HAVING
    COUNT(*) >= 500
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: Les commentaires des clients mecontents sont-ils plus longs que ceux des clients satisfaits ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH commentaires AS (
    SELECT 
        review_score,
        LENGTH(review_comment_message) AS longueur_commentaire,
        CASE 
            WHEN review_score <= 2 THEN 'Mécontent'
            WHEN review_score >= 4 THEN 'Satisfait'
            ELSE 'Neutre'
        END AS satisfaction
    FROM entrepot."order_reviews"
    WHERE review_comment_message IS NOT NULL 
        AND LENGTH(TRIM(review_comment_message)) > 0
)
SELECT 
    satisfaction,
    COUNT(*) AS nombre_commentaires,
    AVG(longueur_commentaire) AS longueur_moyenne,
    MIN(longueur_commentaire) AS longueur_min,
    MAX(longueur_commentaire) AS longueur_max
FROM commentaires
WHERE satisfaction IN ('Mécontent', 'Satisfait')
GROUP BY satisfaction
ORDER BY satisfaction

detail.question: Le chiffre d'affaires du second semestre 2017 est-il superieur a celui du premier ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH paiements_2017 AS (
    SELECT 
        op.payment_value,
        TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS date_commande
    FROM entrepot."order_payments" op
    JOIN entrepot."orders" o ON op.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
      AND TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_commande) <= 6 THEN 'Premier semestre 2017'
        ELSE 'Second semestre 2017'
    END AS semestre,
    SUM(payment_value) AS chiffre_affaires
FROM paiements_2017
GROUP BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_commande) <= 6 THEN 'Premier semestre 2017'
        ELSE 'Second semestre 2017'
    END
ORDER BY semestre
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: Combien de commandes en janvier 2018 contre janvier 2017 ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) >= '2017-01-01' AND TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) < '2017-02-01' THEN 1 END) AS commandes_janvier_2017,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) >= '2018-01-01' AND TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) < '2018-02-01' THEN 1 END) AS commandes_janvier_2018
FROM entrepot."orders"
WHERE TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) >= '2017-01-01'
  AND TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) < '2018-02-01'
LIMIT 1000
